content.text: Selling a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-2|COREMERCH guide to complete]]-deep-dive-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-2|complete]]s. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-crypto-payment-gateways-13|Everything You]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-first-principles-definitive-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The absence of conventional payment platforms in many regions has led to the development of sovereign digital commerce stacks. These stacks are designed to give creators full control over their sales process, from product delivery to payment processing, without relying on restricted platforms. This approach ensures that creators can sell their digital assets, such as ebooks and templates, directly to their audience, bypassing intermediaries and their associated fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this architecture is the integration of free and paid tools that enable automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. For instance, using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, allows for a seamless and efficient sales process. Additionally, leveraging Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery ensures that all aspects of the sales process are well-managed and secure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who have been locked out of conventional payment platforms. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, or presets, this solution provides a viable alternative that is both cost-effective and efficient. By cutting out intermediaries and their high fees—like Gumroad's 10% charge on every sale—creators can retain more of their earnings. For example, with NOWPayments' 0.5% fee, creators can save significantly, with a difference of $921 on 100 sales of a $97 product per month.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks offer a fee-effective alternative to traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this sovereign digital commerce stack are carefully selected to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance. From hosting and backend logic to order storage and file delivery, each element plays a crucial role in facilitating a smooth and secure sales process. Furthermore, the use of NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with support for over 300 cryptocurrencies and a low 0.5% fee, makes it an attractive option for creators looking to expand their payment options without incurring high costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the components that best suit their needs. This might involve choosing between GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages for hosting, or deciding between Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script for backend logic. With the right components in place, creators can then integrate these elements, configure their store, and start selling their digital products with crypto payments. This not only enhances their autonomy over the sales process but also opens up new revenue streams by accepting cryptocurrencies.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can utilize a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates crypto payments. This approach allows for direct sales to the audience, bypassing conventional platforms and their associated fees, thereby increasing earnings. For instance, using NOWPayments for crypto transactions can significantly reduce fees compared to traditional platforms.
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low 0.5% fee.

For creators looking to dive deeper into building their own sovereign digital commerce stacks, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers a comprehensive solution. This kit includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, providing everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a digital commerce stack. Interested creators can find more information and purchase the kit at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, marking the first step towards achieving infrastructure sovereignty and expanding their sales capabilities.
Your Deployment Checklist

To start deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Choose your hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Select a backend logic solution, like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Configure file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Finally, test your setup to ensure a seamless sales process. By following these steps, creators can establish a robust and secure infrastructure for selling their digital products.
